title: Arrival screen's question count matches the walk

requirements.text: The number of questions the arrival screen announces equals the number of question items the walk then presents
requirements.check: Replay a reply whose items block has 0 questions and one with 2; compare the arrival text with the items walked

text: Likely cause, not yet confirmed: the arrival screen counts a snapshot of pending; dropPast (the moved mark, resent on every reconnect) can drop items while it shows. 01:42:32: 'Five updates, one question' then reconnect at 01:43, and no walk. Fix in 0.1.456589: ArrivalScreen counts live pending (WalkPlan.arrivalNow, unit-tested); dropPast logs 'dropped N past items (Q questions)'. Confirm from the bridge log.
Built on: status button (T-37SAG) now clears pending before asking, so the arrival count can't carry old items (11:46 log: 5-item reply announced as 8).
All code committed and shipped in phone build 0.1.456743; no phone build needed. Left: TJ confirms on the phone (or from the bridge log).

Bridge log 14 Nov: 11:46:26 a 5-item status reply was announced as 8 (3 left over from the 11:45 walk + 5 new), and the walk then played the old message's items. That run predates the status-clear fix (T-37SAG, held by another session, uncommitted). The phone has not connected since 12:27Z, so there is no fresh run to read. Gradle test run fails right now on a variant-resolution error in the shared tree (another session is editing mobile/android). Waits on TJ's phone.
